[1/3] Plan editor-only node locks with mutation protection and AI-readable lock state

impact_assessment.why: Large or prefab-heavy scenes can be accidentally transformed or deleted, and there is no lock state for authors or AI clients.
impact_assessment.benefits: Locked nodes and descendants reject transform/delete/reparent/asset/component/prefab edits while remaining selectable; nodes report locked and the document reports locked_ids/locked_count; console Lock/Unlock controls.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 57 and one action; dependency: none; concurrency: editor lock; state: inherited locks, batch actions, refresh_prefab_instances not lock-aware, session-only persistence.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Walk ancestors for effective locks, check mutation branches before history, keep locks session-only, add lock/unlock/error tests and document the remaining refresh gap.

[1/3] Plan named scene-view camera bookmarks persisted per game in localStorage

impact_assessment.why: The editor camera can be reset or focused, but recurring inspection views must be recreated manually every session.
impact_assessment.benefits: Save/apply/delete named camera snapshots with console controls and per-game storage; bookmarks restore target, distance, yaw and pitch.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: UI-only, no API/schema change; dependency: viewer camera state and localStorage; concurrency: none; state: malformed storage, missing camera, option preservation, game key changes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate snapshots in the viewer, guard localStorage parsing, key bookmarks by game, preserve selection, and add static regressions.

impact_assessment.mitigation: Find and test one concrete issue per affected range, run targeted tests plus full AIKit gates, commit conventionally and push without force.

[1/5] Plan: merge-preserving prefab instance refresh, regression tests, console control, docs and full gate

impact_assessment.why: Prefab edits currently propagate to existing instances only by discarding every instance edit; keep_overrides skips overridden instances entirely, so authored per-instance values block template updates. Unity/Unreal-style propagation should update template-owned fields while retaining field-level overrides.
impact_assessment.benefits: Authors can update a prefab once and refresh every instance without losing per-instance names, transforms, assets or components; AI clients get explicit preserved/dropped override counts and one-step undo.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: refresh_prefab_instances keep_overrides semantics and result keys change; dependency: none beyond the existing registry and prefab mapping; concurrency: editor actions remain under the session lock; state: undo snapshots and prefab library files must stay consistent if merge fails.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep default refresh unchanged, make merge atomic inside the existing history transaction, validate every override before mutation, add failing-first web tests for preserve/drop/undo and refresh the schema/docs/ADR.
